name: Kagoshima Castle
description: Kagoshima Castle (Tsurumaru Castle) was the Shimazu clan seat, one of the few Edo castles never completed with a keep. Its gate, stone walls and the Shoko Shuseikan-linked gardens survive; the Reimeikan museum now occupies the site.
notes: The castle grounds are free; the Reimeikan museum (¥500) and the adjacent Isotei garden complete the visit.

ja.name: 鹿児島城
ja.description: 島津氏の居城だった鹿児島城（鶴丸城）。天守は造られず、門と石垣が残り、本丸跡には黎明館があります。
ja.notes: 城跡は無料。黎明館は大人500円です。
